headword: {変温動物|へんおんどうぶつ}

definitions.explanation: An animal whose body temperature varies with the surrounding environment, such as reptiles, amphibians, and fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{蛇|へび}→蛇：02246_hebi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{変温動物|へんおんどうぶつ}だ。
{変温動物|へんおんどうぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{体温|たいおん}→体温：03385_taion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: A cold-blooded animal's body temperature changes with the air temperature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変温動物|へんおんどうぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冬眠|とうみん}→冬眠：15853_toumin⟧や{活動低下|かつどうていか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: When winter comes, many cold-blooded animals enter hibernation or reduced activity.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{変|へん}→変：01124_hen⟧ (changing) + {温|おん} (temperature) + ⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧ (animal). A biology term contrasted with {恒温動物|こうおんどうぶつ} (warm-blooded animal).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {変温動物|へんおんどうぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体温|たいおん}→体温：03385_taion⟧: a cold-blooded animal's body temperature
- {変温動物|へんおんどうぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧: characteristics of cold-blooded animals

SIMILAR / CONTRASTING WORDS:
- {恒温動物|こうおんどうぶつ}: warm-blooded animal — maintains constant body temperature internally (mammals, birds)
- {冷血|れいけつ}⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧: older, less scientific term for cold-blooded animals; can also be used figuratively for a callous person
